entities.summary: Maria Cornelia Gezina "Mona" Keijzer is a Dutch politician. She is currently an independent member of the House of Representatives, after she left the Farmer–Citizen Movement in February 2026. Between 2024 and 2026 she was minister of housing and spatial planning on behalf of BBB in the Schoof cabinet.
